name: vllm_concat_and_cache_mla
description: Faithfully extracted from KernelGenBench test_concat_and_cache_mla.py. Concatenate kv_c and k_pe, write to kv_cache at slot_mapping. Inputs: kv_c (T, kv_lora_rank), k_pe (T, pe_dim), kv_cache (num_blocks, block_size, kv_lora_rank+pe_dim), slot_mapping (randperm int64), scale (scalar 1.0). Reference mutates kv_cache in-place via vLLM _custom_ops.concat_and_cache_mla and returns it. kv_cache_dtype='auto' and scale=1.0 hardcoded. Shapes interdependent → gen_inputs. Workloads use fp16/bf16. Requires vLLM at eval time.
